headline: Heavy rains ravage Faridpur chilli fields, causing prices to soar
summary: Severe weather has devastated crop yields in Faridpur, leading to a significant increase in the cost of chillies.
details: Heavy rainfall has caused widespread damage to chilli fields in Faridpur, leaving farmers struggling with lost crops.
The sudden devastation of the fields has led to a sharp decline in the available supply of chillies in the local markets.
As a result of the supply shortage, the prices of chillies have soared, impacting both farmers and consumers.
Local agricultural experts suggest that the weather patterns are becoming increasingly unpredictable, posing a risk to crop stability.
caption:

headline: 835 die as measles-like symptoms toll rises in Bangladesh
summary: Four more patients died in 24 hours, pushing the total number of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 835, according to the DGHS.
details: Four more patients died with measles-like symptoms in the last 24 hours, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
This brings the combined tally of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths in the country to 835.
Of these fatalities, 739 are suspected measles deaths, while 96 have been laboratory-confirmed.
In the last 24 hours alone, 870 new suspected cases and 135 new confirmed cases were reported.
The cumulative number of suspected cases nationwide has now reached 127,410, with 15,874 laboratory-confirmed infections.
Since March 15, a total of 110,182 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalised across the country, of whom 106,053 have recovered.
caption:
835 deaths and over 127,000 suspected cases. A measles-like outbreak is gripping the country.

Since March 15, a total of 110,182 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalised across the country, of whom 106,053 have recovered.
